facts.claim: Sentry's hosted MCP server endpoint is /mcp (optionally /mcp/{org}[/{project}])
facts.evidence: Vendor docs site and the vendor's GitHub repo both give the remote endpoint https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp.

facts.claim: MCP host and OAuth issuer/authorize/token/register endpoints are all on mcp.sentry.dev
facts.evidence: Discovery document: issuer https://mcp.sentry.dev; endpoints under /oauth/ on the same host.

facts.claim: Sentry's page names no scopes for the hosted server; discovery lists org:read, project:write, team:write, event:write, alerts:write; template leaves scopes empty so the server decides
facts.evidence: scopes_supported: org:read, project:write, team:write, event:write, alerts:write; docs page: scopes not specified.

facts.claim: Dynamic client registration is offered, so no OAuth app has to be created first
facts.evidence: registration_endpoint https://mcp.sentry.dev/oauth/register; docs: All connections use OAuth.

facts.claim: The smoke tool whoami exists (named as an example on the vendor's llms.txt); arguments not stated
npm package @sentry/mcp-server (stdio) latest is 0.42.0; needs a Sentry user auth token and --host for self-hosted
facts.evidence: Registry latest 0.42.0; repo README documents npx @sentry/mcp-server with SENTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN.

facts.claim: A Sentry token can be sent to the hosted server as Authorization: Sentry-Bearer (kept distinct from Bearer)
facts.evidence: Sentry-Bearer is intentionally separate from Bearer.

choices.because: Vendor says all hosted connections use OAuth and discovery advertises a registration endpoint; hosted preferred over the stdio package, which needs a pasted token.
The hosted docs name no scopes; the server decides.
Named on the vendor's llms.txt as a tool.

open: Argument-free behaviour and read-only nature of whoami are not stated in the docs read.
No vendor page was found listing the full tool set or marking tools read/write; no tool-based consent list could be sourced.
The docs say nothing on plan requirements; self-hosted Sentry cannot use the hosted endpoint (stdio package with --host is the route), read on one page.
docs.sentry.io/product/sentry-mcp/ redirects (301) to mcp.sentry.dev; the sheet cites mcp.sentry.dev as the docs.
The GitHub README mentions a local-development OAuth app with a localhost redirect; that is for developing the server, not for using the hosted one.
